full_judgment: 15. The plaintiffs have come with an allegation that plaintiff. Nos.1-15 have acquired 12 annas 5 Gondas 1 Kora 1 Kranti share from disputed khatian by way of inheritance from R.S recorded tenant and plain-tiff No.16 acquired 3 annas 14 Gondas 2 Koras 2 Krantis share on basis of a settlement from Jagadish, one of the recorded tenants. The aforesaid RS Khatian has been prepared in the names of the plaintiffs which were marked as exhibit No.2 series and the same has been denied by the contesting defendants as per section 103-B of Bengal Tenancy Act, entries of the record have a unrebuttable presumptive value. The respondent failed to adduce any cogent evidence with a view to rebut the aforementioned presumption. From the plaint, it appears that Billuda Sundari Saha, Upendranath Saha, Jagadish Chandra Saha, Otul Chandra Saha, Boloram Saha, Lalon Chandra Saha, Derendrandra Nath Saha and Moindra Nath Saha were the owners of the suit land. The inheritance chart and sub-sequent devaluation as has furnished in the plaint has not been challenged by the defendant. Not only that, PW1, Amarandra Nath Saha deposed that Billuda Sundari died leaving behind two sons named Jagadish and Otul. He also deposed that Jagadish had 1 annas 1 Gonda 1 Kora 1 Kranti share and he inherited 2 annas 13 Gondas 1 Kora 1 Kranti share from his mother in the suit Khatian. There is no denial of the fact that plaintiff Nos.1-15 did not inherit the aforementioned share from the RS record tenant.
